categories.wife-hypnotized: Wife hypnotized (by anyone — husband, therapist, villain, vampire, stranger)
categories.pregnant-variants: Pregnancy + mind control — variants and leads

entries.title: Dracula
entries.creator: Bram Stoker
entries.gist: Count Dracula forces Mina Harker into a blood bond that leaves her telepathically linked to him; Van Helsing then hypnotizes her before dawn so she can report Dracula's movements.

entries.title: Trilby
entries.creator: George du Maurier
entries.gist: The musician and hypnotist Svengali puts the tone-deaf artist's model Trilby O'Ferrall under hypnosis and makes her a celebrated singer, 'La Svengali'; she cannot sing once his control ends.
entries.where: Later chapters (her career as 'La Svengali' and collapse after his death)
entries.wife: no (passed off as Svengali's partner; never legally married in the sources)

entries.title: The Avengers #200 (Ms. Marvel / Marcus)
entries.creator: Jim Shooter, David Michelinie, Bob Layton, George Pérez; Marvel
entries.gist: Marcus takes Carol Danvers (Ms. Marvel) to another dimension, rapes and impregnates her; commentators note the story implies he brainwashed her into 'loving' him, and she leaves with him.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — gives birth on Earth to a child who ages into Marcus
entries.note: Brainwashing is implied (critics' reading), so this is a loose fit.

entries.title: Alias (Jessica Jones vs. the Purple Man)
entries.creator: Brian Michael Bendis, Michael Gaydos
entries.gist: Zebediah Killgrave, the Purple Man, uses mind control to put Jessica Jones under his command for months, psychologically torturing her and forcing her into his schemes; she later breaks his control.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — pregnant by Luke Cage at the end of Alias #28
entries.kids_together: yes (with Luke Cage, after the control; daughter Danielle later)

entries.title: Fantastic Four: Malice, Mistress of Hate
entries.creator: John Byrne
entries.gist: Psycho-Man manipulates a depressed Susan Storm into becoming Malice, Mistress of Hate, and she attacks her own family until Reed breaks the control.
entries.kids_before: yes — Franklin; a second pregnancy was stillborn just before (FF #267)

entries.title: The Dark Phoenix Saga
entries.creator: Chris Claremont, John Byrne
entries.gist: Mastermind (Jason Wyngarde), using Emma Frost's mind-tap device, projects illusions into Jean Grey's mind so she believes she is Lady Grey, the Hellfire Club's Black Queen and his lover.

entries.title: Rosemary's Baby
entries.creator: Ira Levin
entries.gist: Rosemary Woodhouse is drugged with a tainted dessert and, in a trance-like dream state during a coven ritual, is raped and impregnated.
entries.pregnant_end: yes — gives birth to the child
entries.kids_together: yes (the child; father is not her husband)
entries.note: Drugging and a ritual, not formal hypnosis — loose fit.

entries.title: Tauros ~Hypnotism Wife NTR~
entries.creator: Yokoyama Naoki
entries.gist: Manager Harada hypnotizes the company president's wife into treating him as her second husband.

entries.title: Tonari no Hitozuma ga Saimin o Kakerarete Netorareta Hanashi
entries.original_title: 隣の人妻が催眠をかけられて寝取られた話 (The Neighbour's Wife Gets Hypnotized and Stolen)
entries.creator: Syomu
entries.gist: With a clap of his hands a college student down the block turns the wife Hitoe into an obedient pet with no memory afterwards.

entries.title: Kuchou ni Saimin Kakerarete Ninshin shichaimashita
entries.original_title: 区長に催眠かけられて妊娠しちゃいました (Hypnotized by the Neighbourhood Head and Got Pregnant)
entries.creator: Nanatsu no Kagiana (Nanakagi Satoshi)
entries.gist: A young couple's talkative neighbourhood-association head persuades them to 'try hypnosis' as a game; they really fall under it and he uses it on the wife.

entries.title: Saiminjutsu de Shinkon Hitozuma Manaka-san to Ecchi Shiyou
entries.original_title: 催眠術で新婚人妻まなかさんとエッチしよう
entries.creator: Sumiyao
entries.gist: Hypnosis makes the newlywed wife Manaka believe the hypnotist is her husband.
entries.pregnant_end: unknown (tagged Pregnancy / Impregnation; described as baby-making)

entries.title: Dragon Ball Z dj – Android 18's Hypnosis NTR
entries.creator: Kaientai (Shuten Douji)
entries.gist: Parody where Android 18, Krillin's wife, is hypnotized and cheated with.
entries.content_label: Hardcore / adult · Fan-made / roleplay (not a professional production)

entries.title: Absolute Hypnosis in Another World
entries.creator: Kamadi, OneDollar (story); Grilled Mero (art)
entries.gist: Transported 'HYPNO' uses hypnosis to build a harem; the first woman he meets in the new world is a married woman.
entries.note: Only the married woman's arc is listed; other targets are not covered here.

entries.title: My Harem Revenge
entries.creator: Flower Storm, Numin (story); Ohlron (art)
entries.gist: Evan, awakened as an incubus, dominates the women who persecuted him one by one, including married women.

entries.title: Panty Note
entries.creator: Wang Kang-cheol (story); Dong Dong-joo (art)
entries.gist: A magic notebook lets its owner seduce any woman whose panties he has seen; married women are among them.

entries.title: Supervisor Access
entries.creator: Kim Duck Jo, Pro Workers (story); Beluga, Park Subeom (art)
entries.gist: An office worker gets system 'missions' and powers to make female co-workers comply.

entries.title: Mind Control Candle
entries.creator: nayak, Soni Silyeowo (story); Ellije Sin (art)
entries.gist: Brad uses a hypnotizing candle on Sophie, an older woman who is 'like a mother' to him.

entries.title: Under His Hypnosis
entries.creator: Neulhana (story); Alice Crazy (art)
entries.gist: Burned-out office worker Heeju answers a mysterious flyer and ends up under a man's hypnosis.

entries.title: Smoking Hypnosis
entries.creator: Dr. Stein
entries.gist: A virtuous woman who hated cigarettes falls into a hypnotist's plot and becomes a heavy smoker and promiscuous.
